findings.summary: read_rows now returns a one-shot generator, but summarize() iterates it twice (any() at line 25, then a for loop at line 28), so any() consumes rows and the second loop misses them, producing wrong totals, an empty summary.high, and a false 'No high-severity audit events today.' message.
Test coverage gap: test_read_rows_is_lazy checks laziness but no test runs summarize() on a log containing a high-severity row, which would have caught the bug.
